title: Yosemite Falls, 1958 Vintage Black & White Snapshot, California
description: A vintage 1958 black-and-white snapshot depicting Yosemite Falls in Yosemite National Park, California. The photo captures the dramatic drop of the waterfall nestled between massive granite cliffs, with pine trees in the foreground. The lower part of the photo shows a slight lens flare or exposure artifact. Handwritten on the reverse side is 'Falls in Yosemite, Summer of '58' alongside a stamped number 98.
